data.description: Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/rival#p1): Shrink the coordination surface before clarifying it: one inventory conversation with the other two marking every currently shared obligation keep, clarify or eliminate, then a four-to-six-week trial of eliminating two or three contested obligations (own-food arrangements, fewer shared items, a tool that deletes a task), watching dispute frequency.
